title: FAIGRI / EAGLE Paper 2: Reproducibility Archive for From National AI Ambition to University Rules
description: Reproducibility archive for the ITT 2026 paper 'From National AI Ambition to University Rules: A Bilingual GCC Evidence-Chain Audit'. The archive preserves locked documentary classifications and reproducibly derives the reported numerical summaries, robustness diagnostics, interval-valued fuzzy representation sensitivities, and figures from them. It also provides source provenance, selected-HEI eligibility certificates, official registry sources, an eligibility-boundary audit, and the documented U search stopping rule. It does not establish implementation quality, sector prevalence, country ranking, causal policy translation, or absence of non-public institutional rules.
notes: RELEASE HOLD: publish only after double-blind review permits an author-identifying public artifact and after the authors select formal licenses. Third-party source documents are not redistributed; official URLs are retained as provenance locators.
